jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.jd_full:
About Dune

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us:

About Dune
https://dune.com/about

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. Since 2018, we have made blockchain data accessible and useful. Our next opportunity is to build products that financial institutions depend on to commit capital, assess risk, and enter new onchain markets.

As these institutions expand their activity on blockchains, they will need reliable, trustworthy and timely data to power decision making across more markets than ever before. They will need to compare opportunities, monitor changes, and integrate data into their existing systems. For Dune these recurring needs will become a substantial and core part of our business.

We are looking for a Head of Product to help transition Dune into this new era. We will build on top of Dune’s existing data foundation, which already powers thousands of companies. You will decide which customers and use cases to serve first, which problems matter most, and which needs can become scalable products for institutional usage.

You will identify valuable customer problems and guide the company to deliver a reliable product and grow its usage.

What we are looking for

You care about markets and have a background in either traditional or onchain markets. You navigate fluently financial jargon and know how market participants use and leverage data.

You can set a clear direction, make difficult choices, and work hard through the details required to deliver. The job’s not finished with a PRD, a hire or a ticket. The job’s finished when the product is creating value in the hands of our customers, being recursively improved by tight knit relationships.

You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.

You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.

In this role you will

  • Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.

  • Own the product experience from data creation to delivery. Set clear requirements for coverage, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.

  • Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.

  • Work with engineering and data teams to deliver reliable datasets, data feeds, and integrations that fit customer systems.

  • Make explicit decisions about scope, quality, and delivery dates. Resolve dependencies and keep important work moving.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales and other teams on customer evaluations, pricing, and adoption. Convert repeated customer needs into products we can serve at scale.

  • Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.

  • Define and improve on our operational practices.

  • Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.

  • Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.

  • Say no and prioritize.

You might be a great fit if

  • You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.

  • You have delivered technically complex data products that customers (ideally institutional) depend on.

  • You understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use it.

  • You have good knowledge of onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs

  • You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.

  • You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.

  • You stay close to the work. You investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and help teams resolve difficult details.

  • You are known to be an excellent communicator.

  • You have startup experience, ideally a former founder or operator.

Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)

  • A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

  • We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

  • On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - GenAI
jobs.jd_full:
Help shape what creative work with AI looks like next.

Generative AI is changing how creative work gets made. Not just the tools people use, but how they riff from an idea to something finished.

At Envato, we’re building for that shift.

We already help millions of creative professionals find the assets and tools they need to create. Now we’re bringing generative AI deeper into that experience, helping customers generate, edit and customise content as part of their everyday workflows.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager, GenAI to help lead where that goes next.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely into this space. You’re using the tools, trying new models, following what’s changing and forming opinions about what is genuinely useful versus what is mostly hype.

And you want the opportunity to turn that curiosity into products used by creative professionals around the world.

What you’ll do

You’ll own the strategy for Envato’s customer facing GenAI experiences, identifying where AI can meaningfully improve creative workflows and taking opportunities from early signals through discovery, launch and iteration.

You’ll spend time understanding how creative professionals actually work, experiment with emerging models and tools yourself, and build a strong point of view about where Envato can create something distinctive.

We want someone who likes making ideas tangible too. That could mean using AI to prototype a concept, vibe coding something quickly or getting hands on with a model to understand what it can really do.

From there, you’ll work closely with Design and Engineering to turn the strongest opportunities into products that balance creative quality and usability with model performance, speed, scale and cost.

What we’re actually looking for

You’re an experienced product leader who has owned strategy and roadmaps for customer facing digital products.

You have deep, hands on fluency in generative AI and generative media. You understand models, APIs and emerging capabilities well enough to work closely with technical teams, and you’re already using AI in your own product work.

You also understand creative people and creative work. Our customers are designers, filmmakers, editors and creators. They care about quality and have a high bar for the tools they use. You need the judgement to understand the difference between an AI output that is technically impressive and one that is genuinely useful in finished professional work.

You’re commercially minded, comfortable using customer insight, data and experimentation to make decisions, and confident connecting product choices to adoption, retention, revenue and cost.

And you can lead through influence. This is a senior individual contributor role working globally across Product, Design, Engineering, external partners and senior leaders, including Executives. You’ll need to communicate clearly, bring people with you and be comfortable making calls when there isn’t an obvious answer.

Why Envato

Because there aren’t many roles where you get to work at the intersection of creative professionals, generative AI and a global product already used at scale.

We’re not interested in adding AI somewhere because we can. We want to work out where it genuinely makes creative work better.

And there is still a lot to figure out. That’s the interesting part.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits include home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, and the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and what to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team.

We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information.

jobs.title: Product Manager, New Content Initiatives and Analysis
jobs.jd_full:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating or licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured content into the AlphaSense platform. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product and content management, collection operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the Content teams and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Product Manager for New Content Evaluation and Analysis to help us expand and strengthen the breadth, quality, and value of the data and content that power our Platform. Candidates should have deep knowledge of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of evaluating and integrating financial research content and AI-powered investment analysis workflows.

Major Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Identify the Need and Showcase the Value: Help identify and evaluate third-party quantitative and qualitative datasets and content for the needs of the AlphaSense platform (e.g. market data, fundamentals, estimates, ESG, news, research, transcripts, regulatory filings, and alternative data). Work alongside Partnership Management and Content Leads to assess data quality, methodology, licensing terms, and integration feasibility.
  • Lead the Due Diligence Effort: Run point individually or leading a due-diligence analyst team on active vendor evaluations, including data trials, support proofs of concept, and own the framework to evaluate coverage, timeliness, accuracy, and history analysis. Help build content org-wide business case for new datasets and quantify value proposition, cost, buy vs build impact, and strategic fit.
  • Become a Use Case Expert for AlphaSense content. Contribute to market research and competitive analysis to identify net new opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Identify new high impact AI-driven functionality and data sets and formulate the licensing target vendor or self-sourcing strategy to introduce new content into the AlphaSense platform and agentic workflows.
  • Market Research and Assessment: Track industry trends and competing platforms, solutions, and content to deliver competitive intelligence and better evolve product and content vision. Keep abreast of a rapidly evolving competitive landscape and client expectations along with unprecedented LLM and AI workflow advances.

Who You Are:

  • You have genuine excitement and passion for corporate finance, capital markets, and investment research coupled with data management expertise demonstrated either in previous capacity at a buy-side or sell-side firm or you have successfully supported AI products/features/data used by investment and data analysis professionals
  • You have natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and investment research and track record of expert-level data analysis at scale using traditional data query or generative AI tools and platforms
  • You have the energy and enthusiasm to work in a high-paced, high-growth environment and you are comfortable accommodating rapidly changing business priorities
  • You have excellent presentation skills with demonstrated ability to inform and influence executives and align with multiple levels of stakeholders
  • You have driven successful due diligence project outcomes or run content evaluations with diverse businesses and teams across multiple locations
  • You demonstrate empathic communication, with the ability to listen and identify problems in need of solutions

REQUIRED

  • At least 5 years of work experience at a leading financial institution or investment research platform firm focused on the delivery or evaluation of content, features, analytics, and models for front-office investment professionals
  • Proficient knowledge of contemporary market data and investment research databases, products, and workflow tools (e.g.: Fundamentals, Estimates, Transactions data, Ownership data, Market data, News, Transcripts)
  • Strong understanding of the logical structure of relational and JSON databases. Demonstrated experience of running complex data queries and analyses using traditional data- query or contemporary generative AI techniques is required. Close familiarity and hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar platforms is a must
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a dedicated cross-functional product development or evaluation teams of engineers, content leads, and vendor management professionals
  • A track record of successful collaboration and delivery with a globally distributed team is a must. Prior formal or informal team leadership experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to set priorities, stay focused, and meet or beat deadlines
  • BSc degree or material academic background in a quantitative analysis field

PREFERRED

  • Experience in content acquisition and licensing
  • Prior experience at a market intelligence or financial research SaaS start-up
  • Exposure to iterative / agile development methodologies in the context of product development
  • Experience working with and leading distributed teams

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (R6371)
jobs.jd_full:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Senior Technical Project Manager – Enterprise Technology & Systems Delivery is a project delivery leader within the PMO organization responsible for managing technology programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams. This role drives delivery from initiation through go-live and stabilization, ensuring tight schedule management, strong cross-functional coordination, proactive risk and issue escalation, and disciplined governance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across engineering, infrastructure, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. Success is defined by on-time execution, stakeholder alignment, effective governance, and sustainable adoption of technology-enabled change.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end project management for technology implementations, platform migrations, system integrations, and transformation initiatives from charter through go-live and hypercare.
  • Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, integrating business, engineering, infrastructure, data, testing, and change activities into a single executable project plan.
  • Build and maintain detailed schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and status reporting.
  • Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT and engineering teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to ensure alignment on scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Facilitate planning, requirements, design, and workstream checkpoint sessions with technical leads and business process owners.
  • Support governance routines, including workstream meetings, status reviews, and escalation paths; help prepare materials for steering committees and leadership updates.
  • Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies through the project governance structure with urgency and clarity.
  • Ensure the project schedule is actively managed and tightly driven, including follow-up on overdue actions, management of critical path items, and resolution of cross-workstream blockers.
  • Coordinate technical and non-technical delivery activities across integrations, infrastructure, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment, without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
  • Support budget tracking, forecast updates, and variance reporting where applicable.
  • Lead preparation for SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live readiness activities in partnership with the appropriate SMEs and delivery leads.
  • Support organizational change management, communications, training coordination, and adoption planning with business and OCM partners.
  • Track vendor and systems integrator delivery performance against plans and milestones.
  • Prepare clear status updates, decision summaries, and risk reports for project leadership.

Required qualifications:

  • 3+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years leading technology implementation or integration projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical programs (e.g., software platform implementations, infrastructure or cloud migrations, system integrations, or enterprise application rollouts).
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
  • Solid understanding of technology delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
  • Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope management, schedule management, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across business, IT, and vendor organizations.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
  • CAPM, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience within a PMO or technology delivery team supporting cross-functional programs.
  • Experience managing technical workstreams across domains such as cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, DevOps/engineering, cybersecurity, or digital/customer platforms.
  • Background in technology transformation, including migration from legacy platforms and coordination of business process change.
  • Exposure to enterprise governance practices, such as steering committee reporting and structured escalation management.
  • Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks and enterprise adoption planning.
  • Prior experience as a business analyst, technical lead, or systems power user is helpful, particularly where that experience improves communication with technical and business teams.

jobs.jd_full:
Please Note: This is a remote position available in the state listed on this job. Additionally, employment with BambooHR is contingent on passing both a background and credit check.

AI at BambooHR

At BambooHR, we’re all about setting people free to do great work, and we believe AI is a powerful partner in that mission. We’re leaning into intelligent tools to streamline our workflows, giving us more time for high-impact innovation. We look for curious, forward-thinking people who are ready to explore how AI can elevate their work and help us reimagine the future of HR.

Essential Job Duties

We’re looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own how agents run at BambooHR: the execution layer they run on, the triggers they respond to, the governance every agent action passes through, and the instrumentation that makes agent work measurable and billable.

This is the first dedicated product seat for a surface every team building agents depends on. Teams building agents have no product front door today, and you will be it. You’ll inherit production load, real consumers, and years of accumulated architecture. No roadmap or vision document is waiting for you, so you’ll create the roadmap.

You will:

  • Own product direction for the Agent Runtime: durable execution, human-in-the-loop gates, auditability, and capacity and reliability posture as agent count grows.
  • Be the product lead accountable for an architecture decision on the legacy agent platform.
  • Own a dated migration plan onto a new runtime, sequenced by consumer impact so downstream AI experiences never discover a regression by surprise.
  • Own agent governance as a product: the trust framework every agent action passes through before acting, built on the BambooHR platform’s authorization and attribution patterns.
  • Define and drive usage instrumentation, including instigation flags, output lifecycle events, and a metering schema that keeps the company’s monetization options open.
  • Run intake and prioritization for every team building agents, and publish an answer on whether to build on what exists now or wait for that runtime.
  • Draw and maintain the boundary between the platform agents run on and the AI experience surfaces built on it, with named consumer stakeholders on every decision that touches them.
  • Coordinate how agents are triggered: which platform events agents may respond to, and what subscribing to them requires.
  • Be the named consumer stakeholder on context and signal standards, say what agents need from workplace signals, and take part in decisions that affect how agents use them.

Success in the First 180 Days

  • Deliver a written architecture decision for the legacy agent platform, with a dated migration plan sequenced by consumer.
  • Stand up an intake path for teams building agents and publish guidance on whether to build now or wait for that runtime.
  • Establish runtime capacity and reliability reporting that leadership can act on.
  • Ship the first version of the metering schema, with instigation and lifecycle events flowing.

What You Need to Get the Job Done

  • You feel aligned with the BambooHR values.
  • 5+ years of product management experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products.
  • Technical depth in execution systems, workflows, or eventing. You can reason about durable execution, retries, and what makes a migration safe.
  • Experience as the product owner for internal platform consumers, with intake discipline, published contracts, and a roadmap those consumers can see.
  • Proven ability to drive alignment across teams without direct authority.
  • Judgment to make migration calls where engineering convenience and consumer safety pull in different directions.
  • Comfort with AI and agent systems, and with how quickly their patterns change.
  • You instrument before you assert, write decisions down, and sequence work by consumer impact.

What Will Make Us REALLY Love You

  • Experience with agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, or workflow engines such as Temporal.
  • Migration or sunset leadership on a system with live production consumers.
  • Product experience with usage-based pricing or metering.

What You’ll Love About Us

  • Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance
  • Generous leave policies that include 4 weeks of vacation, 12 company holidays, parental leave, and volunteer time off so you can enjoy quality of life
  • 401k plans with up to 6% company match
  • $2000 Paid-Paid Vacation bonus
  • EAP through Headspace

At BambooHR, we’re building something different: we’re building a people intelligence platform that transforms HR and sets people free to do great work! We’re a proven market leader driving innovation while building lasting success through thoughtful, sustainable growth. Here, you’ll find a place that champions growth: both professional and personal, both individual and collective.

We invest in potential, giving you the space to stretch your capabilities and turn good ideas into reality while providing the safety net of a supportive, values-driven culture. Our approach combines meaningful work with meaningful lives, offering competitive benefits, professional development, and the flexibility to thrive both in and outside the office.

What sets us apart isn’t just what we do, but how we do it: with openness, integrity, and a shared commitment to doing the right thing. Join us in creating HR software that makes work better for everyone, while we make work better for you.

jobs.title: LUCA SAP Finance Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

About us

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.

Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.

Are you striving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!

Job Description

The LUCA program

LUCA is METRO’s strategic SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation program. It safeguards business continuity and addresses security and compliance risks while enabling greater standardization, harmonization and centralization across Finance. Alongside new-country rollouts, the program continuously evolves and supports the productive solution used by countries already live on LUCA.

Purpose of the role

Based in Düsseldorf, Germany, the SAP Finance Project Manager will lead the delivery of change projects for LUCA countries already operating on the productive SAP S/4HANA Finance solution. Typical assignments include the implementation of new electronic-invoicing mandates, other legal and regulatory requirements, and business-driven changes that affect Finance processes, integrations, data, controls and operational procedures.

The role is designed for an experienced SAP Financials professional who has moved into project coordination and delivery management. The Project Manager must understand Finance requirements and SAP solution implications well enough to structure work, challenge plans, connect the correct experts and drive decisions, while remaining accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and stakeholder alignment in a large international SAP landscape.

Your responsibilities

End-to-end project delivery

  • Own the delivery of assigned SAP Finance projects for LUCA live countries from initiation and scoping through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and closure.
  • Translate legal, regulatory and business change requests into structured projects with clear objectives, scope boundaries, deliverables, milestones, governance, resource needs and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering functional design, technical implementation, interfaces, data, testing, cutover, communication, training and operational readiness.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions and change control, ensuring that deviations are visible and addressed early.
  • Prepare concise status reporting, decisions and recommendations for LUCA governance, country stakeholders and management.

Regulatory and business change delivery

  • Coordinate the implementation of country-specific electronic-invoicing mandates and other legal or tax-driven changes, working with Finance local, central, system implementors, and partner-system specialists.
  • Lead business-change projects that enhance or adapt live SAP Finance processes, ensuring alignment with the LUCA global template and the needs of productive operations.
  • Ensure requirements are sufficiently clear, approved and traceable, and that legal effective dates and business deadlines are translated into realistic delivery plans.
  • Coordinate impact assessments across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba where relevant, master data, reporting, authorizations, interfaces and non-SAP partner systems.
  • Protect productive operations by ensuring controlled releases, appropriate regression testing, cutover planning, support readiness and post-go-live monitoring.

Functional and technical coordination

  • Use prior SAP Financials experience to understand end-to-end process impacts, ask informed questions and facilitate productive alignment between business and technology teams.
  • Coordinate solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, test teams, release management, AMS, country organizations and external partners.
  • Identify interdependencies across processes, systems, countries and concurrent initiatives, assign ownership and drive decisions and actions to closure.
  • Challenge delivery proposals, estimates and solution approaches constructively, while relying on accountable architects and specialists for detailed design authority.
  • Ensure project outputs are documented, supportable and handed over effectively to the relevant live-country and service-management organizations.

Testing, deployment and stakeholder management

  • Work with LUCA Test Management to define the test approach, business participation, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, defect governance and acceptance evidence for each project.
  • Coordinate country UAT and business acceptance, ensuring the right stakeholders are mobilized and that open defects and residual risks are transparent before deployment.
  • Plan and govern cutover and production deployment activities with clear responsibilities, sequencing, readiness checks, fallback considerations and management communication.
  • Act as the central project contact for country Finance stakeholders, LUCA teams, METRO Digital, the System Integrator and other delivery partners.
  • Build trust across cultures and time zones through transparent communication, dependable follow-up, pragmatic issue resolution and timely escalation.

Qualifications

Required key competencies and qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in SAP Finance delivery, including substantial earlier experience in SAP Financials followed by a successful move into project coordination or project management.
  • Solid functional understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance processes and integration points, with experience in one or more areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, tax or financial interfaces.
  • Proven experience delivering SAP changes or projects in a large, international and multi-country SAP landscape.
  • Experience managing legal, regulatory, tax, electronic-invoicing or other deadline-driven change initiatives is highly advantageous.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, country organizations, AMS providers, System Integrators and technology partners without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Experience across testing, UAT, cutover, release, deployment and hypercare in productive SAP environments.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Ariba, invoice-management solutions, integration platforms or partner-system landscapes is advantageous.
  • Confident use of project planning, collaboration and reporting tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or SAP certification is advantageous but not required; retail or wholesale experience is beneficial.
  • Visible “can-do” attitude, with the energy and persistence to move complex topics forward, remove obstacles and find pragmatic paths to delivery.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, combined with disciplined planning, follow-up, risk management and escalation.
  • Ability to understand functional and technical discussions, structure ambiguity and translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.
  • Confident, articulate communication and stakeholder-management skills across business, Finance, technology, vendors and senior management.
  • Collaborative and culturally aware working style suited to distributed international teams and multiple country stakeholders.
  • Calm and solution-oriented under pressure, particularly when managing fixed legal deadlines or production-critical changes.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required.

Additional Information

What do we offer at METRO.digital?

  • Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.

At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.

  • People development: when you grow so do we!

We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation … it´s time to upskill your career.

  • Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!

We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.

Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here.

Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!

Position grade within our career framework: Project Manager Grade 3 (Md9).

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Clerkie

Clerkie is a fintech startup on a mission to democratize financial wellness using the power of artificial intelligence. Launched in 2018, Clerkie began with an app, aiming to help the nearly 123 million underserved Americans in need of financial guidance. Since its inception, the company has expanded its services and now pairs consumer guidance with cutting-edge B2B software. By pairing the two through the Clerkie network, these tools have become the go-to resource for creditors looking to manage loan losses while simultaneously helping millions of borrowers get out of debt.

Clerkie is a remote-first company, with over 40 employees spanning 4 time zones across the United States. To date, the company has raised $41 million, including a $33 million Series A round in early 2023. Investors include leading financial and venture institutions, including Citi Ventures, Left Lane Capital, Wellington Ventures, Flourish Ventures, and Vestigo Ventures.

About the role

We’re looking for a driven, curious, and collaborative Associate Product Manager to join our small-but-mighty Product team. This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their product career - whether this is your first formal PM role or your second - who’s ready to take on real ownership, build strong fundamentals, and grow alongside experienced product leaders.

You’ll work closely with our Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and directly with our CEO and co-founder, supporting both our consumer-facing experiences and our B2B platform. This is a hands-on role where you’ll contribute meaningfully across discovery, delivery, and iteration - while learning how product decisions get made in a fast-paced Series A environment.

Our goal is for this role to be a true launchpad: building the skills, judgment, and confidence needed for long-term growth in product at Clerkie or beyond.

Here’s what you’ll do

  • Partner with PMs, designers, and engineers to explore problems and shape solutions
  • Work directly on high-priority initiatives across our SaaS products
  • Support discovery, documentation, and delivery for key product work streams
  • Join (and contribute to!) team rituals like sprint planning, retros, and roadmap reviews
  • Help scope and ship features from research through release
  • Keep the team organized with clear requirements, thoughtful tracking, and great communication
  • Bring fresh eyes, user empathy, and curiosity to everything you touch

Here’s a snapshot of what the Product team tackled recently

  • Partnered with Design and Engineering to create some super slick sandbox demos that helped us win big deals
  • Contributed to high-priority builds for enterprise partners, pressure-testing our infrastructure to support scale
  • Collaborated directly with our SLT to scope and prioritize key updates across multiple product experiences
  • Added our voice to the evolving product strategy and roadmap, helping shape how Clerkie and Fiber deliver value across every touchpoint
  • Helped clean up and organize Coda, our internal knowledge hub, to make life easier for future new hires (like you!)
  • Onboarded a new teammate to the Product team and updated internal rituals to set them up for success
  • Spent the day on a private ranch in Jackson Hole horseback riding, axe throwing, eating outside a Michelin Star chef’s table, roasting smores under the stars, and celebrating your latest hackathon win
  • And more! From big wins to team traditions, it’s been a month - and we’re just getting started 😎

Must-haves

  • Early experience working in a product-focused role
  • Ability to clearly communicate across various technical teams, clients, and stakeholders
  • Top-notch communication and organization skills
  • Ability to think in systems, break down complex ideas, and prioritize clearly
  • Curiosity, humility, and a desire to learn from others
  • Motivation to own your work and grow fast
  • A collaborative spirit and appreciation for feedback
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment

Nice-to-haves (not required)

  • Prior experience in a startup (Seed stage to pre-IPO), fintech, or adjacent company
  • Familiarity with Agile, Jira, Coda, or Figma
  • Background in CS, business, design, analytics, or another relevant field
  • A basic understanding of how software gets built
  • Passion for financial wellness, tech-for-good, or startup life

Our salary and benefits

  • 💰 Salary range : $90-110k
  • 💼 Equity
  • 💻 Remote-first role (US only)
  • 🧘 Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 📈 401(k) + retirement benefits
  • 🌴 Paid time off + annual company retreat
  • 💻 Company laptop + home office stipend
  • 💙 Collaborative, values-driven culture

Our hiring process

We believe in a two-way interview process that helps us get to know you - and helps you get to know us.

  1. Application(async)
  2. Intro Call w/ People Team (15 - 20 min)
  3. Take-Home Challenge (async over 1 week)

Before we extend any offers, all candidates must successfully complete a standard background check in addition to a reference check. These checks are conducted in tandem to ensure a safe, secure, and compliant environment for all Clerkie team members and stakeholders. We approach this stage with transparency and sensitivity, and candidates will be provided with clear information about the process.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.jd_full:

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.

The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

About This Role:

TrueML is on a mission to humanize the recovery process for distressed borrowers through AI and machine learning. As our Senior Product Manager you will be the person who brings conversational AI to life inside our platform — across voice, chat, and the messaging channels our consumers and clients already use.

What You’ll Do:

  • Roadmap & Strategy: Define and own the conversational AI roadmap across voice and chat, balancing consumer impact, client demand, operational readiness, and platform build-vs-adopt decisions.

  • Conversation Design & Omnichannel Integration: Establish behavior standards for AI agents—including authentication, intent recognition, hardship handling, and human handoffs—ensuring a unified consumer experience across voice, chat, SMS, and email.

  • Partnerships & Technical Surface: Manage vendor relationships and specify requirements for telephony and CRM/servicing system integrations.

  • Performance & Compliance: Drive operational metrics (latency, containment, cost per resolution) while partnering with Legal and Compliance to adhere to regulatory frameworks like FDCPA, Reg F, and TCPA.

  • Cross-Functional Operational Readiness: Prepare Operations, Client Success, and Compliance teams with training, runbooks, escalation paths, and key metrics prior to feature launches.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: 5+ years of 0-1 Product Management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved business metrics. Fintech, collections, lending, or other regulated financial services experience is a strong plus.

  • LLM Experience: You have shipped LLM-based capabilities in production. You can reason about prompting, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, latency, and failure modes well enough to partner credibly with engineers — and to know when an impressive demo is not yet a product.

  • Conversational AI Fluency (hard requirement): Hands-on experience with voice agents, chat agents, IVR, or contact center technology.

  • Strong Analytical Skills: When you have a question about conversation or outcome data, you answer it yourself.

  • The “Double-Sided” Mindset: Experience with B2B2C products, balancing what the client configures against what the consumer experiences.

  • A Master of Ambiguity: You thrive in “roll-up-your-sleeves” environments where the path isn’t always marked, turning conflicting inputs into solid, actionable plans.

$136,000 - $180,000 a year
